mentions.name: Simulator Language Parser
mentions.description: A parser for the simulator's own input language, so the circuit simulator can run on known inputs and automatically enforce asserts, letting the machine check results instead of the author.
mentions.source_excerpt: So far I've built a digital circuit simulator, a parser for my circuit design language, and now a parser for my simulator language (so I can run the sim on known inputs and have the machine enforce asserts for me). All to avoid the painful memories I have of verilog/vhdl.
